coverage_scope: Published domestic and worldwide international routes from the selected Bahrain civilian airports, both directions; other existing national captures reused without new searches. Seasonal candidates are not dated service evidence; coverage is partial.
replay_note: Bahrain · Flights departing 2 November 2026 in each origin airport’s local time, including overnight arrivals. Timeline: Bahrain time (UTC+3); airport boards use local time. New quotes use USD; reused quotes retain their original currencies. Coverage and prices are partial. Empty results mean not returned, not no service. Paths are illustrative.
collection_strategy: Published Bahrain airport routes, one origin-local date; reused quotes unchanged, new captures USD
